name: pos-m0-protocol-freeze
title: POS campaign M0: freeze protocol.json (tamper matrix + per-class fingerprints), two-pronged viability, and full-profile cost calibration
description: First implementation milestone of the proof-or-stop evidence-instrument replay and tamper campaign whose rev-3 pre-registration landed as DONE story B-e86f (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md). M0 must FREEZE protocol.json BEFORE any scored run. It is the foundation the M1-M4 harnesses read: it fixes N per scale (calibrated), the content-inert seed constant, the tamper-class matrix split into a FAIL-CLOSED set (each class carrying a failure signal, with its expected fingerprint over the explicit domain = boolean verify-flag vector + numeric-metric predicates) and an ACCEPTANCE bucket (self-consistent verify-accepted combinations), the iterationId cross-product rule, the recordDigest preimage rule, budget caps, the stop-reason enum, and env pins. Every candidate tamper class must be demonstrably viability-checked (each mutation produces a byte/contract difference AND fail-closed classes carry a failure signal) and dispositioned fail-closed|accepted|dropped. One measured full-profile (1,000,000-record) generate+verify sets the full budget cap and final full-N. All artifacts live under experiments/pos-instrument-replay/.
